title: Expected payoff and local expected value
statement: Let $D$ and $V$ be finite sets, and let a constraint satisfaction instance on $V$ have a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs. If each variable is assigned an independent random label with its specified law on $D$, then the expected fraction of satisfied constraints equals the instance's local expected value computed from those laws.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
